findings.title: Lab API has no rate limiting or request-body error signalling
evidence: tools/lab_api_server.py:88-98 `_read_json` returns {} for oversize/invalid JSON, so malformed requests fall through to 400/404 without diagnosis
tools/lab_api_server.py:119-190 no rate limit or concurrency cap on POST /run
findings.impact: A misbehaving client can queue unbounded shell jobs; invalid payloads produce misleading errors.
findings.recommendation: Return 400 on invalid JSON and add a simple concurrency/rate guard.

findings.title: Lab API contract is documented in prose only (no schema)
evidence: runbooks/LAB_API.md and tools/lab_api_server.py docstring describe the endpoints
findings.impact: Client/server drift (e.g. the /sync token bug) is not caught by a contract test.
findings.recommendation: Add a small JSON schema or shared constants module used by both server and client.

report: The only HTTP API is the lab job API (`tools/lab_api_server.py`) with its client (`tools/lab_runner.py`). Endpoints: GET /health, GET /repos, POST /sync, POST /run.
